What the measures show — the story over training

One recurring picture across all settings. "Rich" vs "lazy" is just the initialization scale: small init = rich (large feature movement), large init = lazy (frozen near init).

  • 1
    Loss converges ~50× before the circuit. loss_gap hits the Bayes floor by ~step 1k, but attn_decay_ratio stays at ≈1 (uniform attention) until a late, abrupt drop toward η (~step 8–12k). The geometry is a late acquisition — you must sample the late regime densely.
  • 2
    The attention pattern barely matters to the loss. loss_decomp/skipbigram — the only term the profile controls — is ~0.2% of the total loss. Almost no gradient pulls the profile into shape, which is exactly why it forms late, sharply, and only sometimes.
  • 3
    Components form in order: logits → OV/value circuit → attention pattern. conv/logits drops first, rank/ov_circuit collapses to ≈1 early, and conv/attention settles last. The linear circuit forms first, the attention pattern second.
  • 4
    η, not the eigenvalue. In the rich regime attn_decay_ratio lands below the process eigenvalue (two-state → η≈0.41 < λ=0.5; Mess3 → η*≈0.47 < ζ=0.55). The eigenvalue is a red herring.
  • 5
    Initialization picks the circuit, early and irreversibly. Small init → decay→η, value/ov_gain→+0.08, and (Mess3) ov_direction_cos→1.0. Large init reaches the same loss with uniform attention and a collapsed OV direction. See it sweep across the init lines.
  • 6
    The paper's belief geometry is real on Mess3. mse_mid_constrained is low (constrained fractal linearly present) and ov_direction_cos=1.0 — both vacuous on two-state (state-emitting, constrained ≡ π), which is why we run the edge-emitting Mess3.
  • 7
    Staging is causal (freeze settings). Freeze→unfreeze lands on the same function as joint training and reaches η; freeze-forever stays at uniform decay (≈1) yet still hits near-optimal loss. Interventions (lr, bias, freeze-K) move the rich↔lazy boundary but never cross it.
1-layer · 1 head · d=64 · no LayerNorm · RoPE attention-only (no MLP) ~120M tokens · 53 checkpoints (dense late) η (two-state) = 0.4071 · ζ (Mess3) = 0.55, η* ≈ 0.47
